hub.description: Real-Time Data vs a Static Database

data.title: Simpleads vs Apollo.io: Real-Time Data vs a Static Database
data.intro:
Apollo.io built one of the largest B2B contact databases on the market — 275M+ contacts, plus a full engagement suite with sequencing and a dialer bundled in. Simpleads takes a narrower, sharper approach: a five-step real-time pipeline (People, Company, Jobs, Scoring, Export) that cross-references hiring signals and re-scores relevance on every run, instead of serving from a periodically-refreshed database.
Both are strong tools. The right one depends on whether you need Apollo's database scale and built-in sequencing, or Simpleads' tighter real-time targeting, hiring-signal cross-referencing and local (Google Maps) coverage.

data.content: Apollo's database is genuinely larger and more mature, with a longer track record of coverage across roles and industries. Simpleads covers 250M+ professionals with the same title/seniority/verified-contact filtering, prioritizing real-time re-verification over raw database size.

items.q: What's a good alternative to Apollo.io with real-time data verification?
items.a: Simpleads re-checks contact and hiring-signal data on each pipeline run rather than serving purely from a static, periodically-refreshed database.

items.q: How does Simpleads compare to Apollo.io for hiring signal data?
items.a: Simpleads includes a built-in Jobs step that cross-references your lead list against live job postings — not a core, comparable feature in Apollo.io.

items.q: Which tool is better for local business prospecting, Simpleads or Apollo?
items.a: Simpleads includes a dedicated Google Maps Search workflow for local business prospecting; this isn't a core focus of Apollo.io's platform.

items.q: Does Simpleads include email sequencing like Apollo?
items.a: No — Simpleads is a sourcing, scoring and export pipeline. Exports push directly into HubSpot, Salesforce, or the sequencing tool of your choice, including Apollo itself.
